name: The Brotherhood

tenures.source: the promotion's own 1 August 1995 tapings recap and 4 August 1995 results card

caption: Won the vacant NWF Tag Team Championship in a five-team elimination match at TV tapings and retained it against the Masked Destroyers on 4 August 1995, the last tag title defense in this record's own read window.

identity.note: A same-named entity is already elsewhere in the held record under an unrelated federation; no document ties the two records together.
